 Canadiens at Maple Leafs projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 07, 2026 
 Link copied 
 CANADIENS (10-3-3) at MAPLE LEAFS (8-7-2) 
 7 p.m. ET; TVAS, SN 
 Canadiens projected lineup 
 Cole Caufield -- Nick Suzuki -- Juraj Slafkovsky
 Chris Kreider -- Jake Evans -- Alex Newhook
 Zachary Bolduc -- Phillip Danault -- Alexandre Texier
 Oliver Kapanen -- Owen Beck -- Kirby Dach
 Lane Hutson -- Noah Dobson
 Kaiden Guhle -- Alexandre Carrier
 Arber Xhekaj -- Adam Engstrom
 Jacob Fowler
 Jakub Dobes
 Scratched: Florian Xhekaj, Josh Anderson 
 Injured: Mike Matheson (lower body), Ivan Demidov (lower body), Samuel Montembeault (lower body) 
 Maple Leafs projected lineup 
 Easton Cowan -- Auston Matthews -- Jack Roslovic
 John Tavares -- Nick Paul -- William Nylander
 Dakota Joshua -- Colton Sissons -- Gavin McKenna
 Brandon Duhaime -- Teddy Blueger -- Zack MacEwen
 Morgan Rielly -- Chris Tanev
 Jake McCabe -- Darren Raddysh
 Oliver Ekman-Larsson -- Troy Stecher
 Sergei Bobrovsky
 Artur Akhtyamov
 Scratched: Dakota Mermis, Vinnie Lettieri, Anthony Stolarz 
 Injured: Max Domi (undisclosed), Kirill Marchenko (lower body), Marshall Rifai (lower body), Nick Blankenburg (upper body) 
 Status report 
 The Canadiens did not hold a morning skate. Anderson, a forward, will not play for personal reasons and will be replaced by Beck. ... Tavares will return after missing the past nine games with a lower-body injury. He will replace Joshua, a forward, on the second line. ... Akhtyamov was recalled from Toronto of the American Hockey League and will back up Bobrovsky. Stolarz will start against the New Jersey Devils on Sunday.
